description: This file defines the RootView SwiftUI component for managing navigation between authentication and dashboard views in a SwiftUI app.

classes.name: RootView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that serves as the main entry point for navigation between authentication and dashboard, depending on the user's authentication state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view hierarchy and conditional navigation based on authentication state.

methods.name: authFlow
methods.description: A private computed property that provides the authentication flow interface, toggling between SignUpView and LoginView.
